question.problem: Let ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14272903/assets/2debd308641e5f8dcc6a2a2c9a8f9ed148163d82d74ce7c799c886155cc49db0.svg) and ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14272903/assets/0cf190a45ebca5f3e7a5de630b3d819f044e00c1e0b3f97467774a98d9775e17.svg). Given that $\mathbf{a} \perp \mathbf{b}$, find the value of $t$.
question.worked_solution:
We know that $\mathbf{a} \perp \mathbf{b}$ ($\mathbf{a}$ and $\mathbf{b}$ are perpendicular) if and only if $\mathbf{a} \cdot \mathbf{b} = 0.$

Computing the dot product, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}a\cdot b & ={a}_{x}\cdot {b}_{x}+{a}_{y}\cdot {b}_{y}+{a}_{z}\cdot {b}_{z} \\  & =4\cdot (-2)+(-2)\cdot 5+1\cdot t \\  & =-8-10+t \\  & =t-18.\end{aligned}
$$

Setting the dot product equal to $0,$ we obtain:

$$
\begin{aligned}a\cdot b & =0 \\ t-18 & =0 \\ t & =18\end{aligned}
$$
